item.title: 【DVD】DVD5 - Forró Duquesa - Ao Vivo em Palmares-PE (2005) - Untouched Video_TS - Rare Brazilian Forró
item.description:
I am sharing a very rare piece of Brazilian musical history, specifically from the "Forró Eletrônico" scene in Pernambuco. This is the live performance of Forró Duquesa, recorded in Palmares-PE circa 2005.
This band was part of the romantic forró wave in Northeastern Brazil. While many recordings from this era only exist in low-quality VHS rips on YouTube, I managed to acquire a brand new, factory-sealed original DVD.
I have performed a 1:1 bit-perfect extraction of the original files. No re-encoding, no compression. This is the highest quality available for this concert.
Technical Highlights:
  • Source: Original Retail DVD (Sealed copy)
  • Format: Untouched .VOB (VIDEO_TS folder)
  • Video: MPEG-2 / NTSC / 720x480
  • Audio: This is the best part—it features a rare 5.0 Surround Mix. Unlike the compressed stereo versions found online, this track offers great instrument separation and dynamic range, sounding perfect on headphones or home theater systems.
